decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster builds on the firm's core coolant management business, so carrying it costs little, and with only one year on the market its value is still unresolved, which makes the option worth holding.
The centrifuge extends the established filtration offer with low incremental cost, and nothing in its short market record shows that its value will fail to materialize.
Coolant nozzles are a cheap complementary item that supports system sales, so the low carrying cost justifies keeping the option open.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits close to the core conveyor portfolio, where demand from metalworking users is steady, and keeping it costs little.
The magnetic belt conveyor is a niche variant within the modular conveyor platform, and its prospects remain uncertain after only one year, so the low-cost option is worth retaining.
The hinged belt conveyor is a standard core product line with low carrying cost and no evidence of failure, so the firm keeps it.
